title: A Limit-Free Algebraic-Geometric Construction of the Derivative with a Foundational Model in the Class of Polynomial Functions
summary: This paper presents an algebraic-geometric construction of the derivative developed initially within the class of polynomial functions without introducing limits at the initial stage. Tangency is characterized by an algebraic condition: the difference between a function and a linear approximation has a double root at a given point. On this basis, the derivative is defined as a functional correspondence assigning to each point the slope of the tangent.
